dedupe_keys.name: latvia cadastre information system open data buildings land units and cadastral values vzd

description: The State Land Service of Latvia publishes the current public data of its Cadastre Information System as two weekly open datasets on the national portal. The text data, in XML with XSD schemas, cover real properties and their composition, ownership status, land units and their parts, buildings, groups of premises, registered addresses, encumbrances, marks, and assessments with cadastral values; the building data include structural elements and physical depreciation (their presentation changed in April 2025), and fiscal and universal cadastral values were added to the assessments in December 2024. The spatial data are the cadastral map, a digital overview built from cadastral survey vectors covering the whole country in LKS-92 TM, showing land unit boundaries and boundary points, the outer outline and position of each building on its land unit, and servitude areas, as shapefiles per municipality. Coverage: all of Latvia. Access: free downloads on data.gov.lv, updated weekly. Licence: CC BY 4.0. Caveats: restricted data such as objects important for national security are withheld, as are data available only to identified persons, including owners and users and the fittings and characteristics of premises; the data structure changed on 20 April 2026. Simulation uses are building outlines with structural elements, depreciation and cadastral values for exposure, vulnerability and loss models. Related records: the Czech RÚIAN register and the Danish BBR register.
